Skittering Spiders#000.src: You should report back to Yahya and tell him the spiders have been cleared out.
Skittering Spiders#000.dst: 你应该回去告诉 Yahya，蜘蛛已经清理干净了。

Skittering Spiders#001.src: I-is it done? S-s-spiders... No more spiders? Is my m-mushroom patch cl-... cleared?
Skittering Spiders#001.dst: 解、解决了吗？蜘、蜘、蜘蛛……没有蜘蛛了？我的蘑、蘑菇地清……清理干净了？

Skittering Spiders#003.src: Well, it looks cleared to me. These are... uh... some fine mushrooms!
Skittering Spiders#003.dst: 嗯，在我看来已经清理干净了。这些是……呃……挺不错的蘑菇！

Skittering Spiders#004.src: Th-thank you soldiers! That was-... I mean. It was f-fine, I g-... guess.
Skittering Spiders#004.dst: 谢、谢谢你们，士兵们！那真是——……我是说。还、还行吧，我、我想。

Skittering Spiders#006.src: I am everywhere. M-mushroom soup, stew, soup m-makes me fast!
Skittering Spiders#006.dst: 我无处不在。蘑、蘑菇汤、炖菜，汤让我变、变快！
